title: Irrigation Request Form
subtitle: Farm Irrigation: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Irrigation Request Form covers field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response. The irrigation coordinator records Farm Irrigation need, timing, access, and assignment. Irrigation Request Form keeps Farm Irrigation exceptions visible until the irrigation coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Irrigation Request Form at water source, pump station, mainline, valve zone, field, and runoff boundary. Document field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response identity before Farm Irrigation begins. Compare field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response findings with stated Farm Irrigation criteria; route unresolved Farm Irrigation issues to farm water-system reviewer.
